saw_lines: Women buy a hair supplement for one problem, like shedding, then reorder it for months if they notice change.
So the sale is won in the first line, when a woman with the problem decides whether this is the fix.
Your 8 of 26 copy ads share one exact copy, so keep the body text but write a new first line and a fresh scene for each of those 8.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: One copy runs in 8 of your 26 copy ads, so buyers tune the message out. Keep the body text, but write a new first line and shoot a fresh scene for each, like the pack in a bathroom routine.
None of your 26 copy ads carries a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Pick one real count, like reviews or orders shipped, and open the next ads with it.

8 of your 26 copy ads open on the same line, “cuidar el pelo va mucho”, so buyers meet one hook again and again. Test new angles against it, such as the price question and a customer quote about week one.

4 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of your other copy ads reuses their opening line. Build the next ads as variations of the oldest one, keeping its first line and product while changing only the shot and setting.
